question.problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{aligned}]},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}0 & b & 4 \\ a & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & c\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T({b}_{1})=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 9 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{3})=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 0 \\ 10\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
Let's denote the vectors of $B$ as ${{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}.$ The $B$-matrix for $T$ is a matrix whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B.$

To find the coordinates of $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B$, we consider the matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}| & | & | & | & | & | \\ {b}_{1} & {b}_{2} & {b}_{3} & T({b}_{1}) & T({b}_{2}) & T({b}_{3}) \\ | & | & | & | & | & |\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we reduce the left-hand side to reduced row echelon form using Gaussian elimination. Then, on the right-hand side, we will obtain the $B$-matrix for $T:$

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 3 & 9 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 0 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 0 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-2{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 0 & 0 & 10\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}0 & -7 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Finally, $a=1,$ $b=-7,$ $c=2$ and 

$$
a+b+c=1+(-7)+2=-4.
$$
